rule: Terms of Use: "You must be at least 13 years old."
source_title: Instagram Terms of Use
note: Accounts of users aged 13-17 are Teen Accounts; users 13-15 need a parent to loosen default settings (see Teen Accounts page).

rule: Teen Accounts: users 13-17 get protected default settings; 13-15 need parental permission to make them less strict.

note: Feature row, not a separate sign-up age.

rule: Terms of Service section 3.1: you cannot use Facebook if you are under 13 years old.

rule: Terms of Service (US version): "You must be at least 13 years old to use the Service"; children of all ages may use YouTube and YouTube Kids if enabled by a parent.

rule: Terms of Service (EEA version, e.g. gl=DE, gl=PT): "You may use the Service if you are at least 16 years old"; children of all ages may use it if enabled by a parent.
under_min_option: YouTube Kids or a parent-supervised experience
source_title: YouTube Terms of Service (gl=DE)
note: The EEA terms state 16 even where the Google Account age is lower (e.g. Portugal, 13). Under 16 needs a parent to enable use.
